name: Spark Settings
summary: SparkOS's own settings: displays, sound, network, Bluetooth, appearance, mouse and keyboard, shortcuts, notifications, power, default apps, startup, users, date and language, printers and storage. KDE's modules stay only as a last resort.
summary_fr: Les réglages de SparkOS : écrans, son, réseau, Bluetooth, apparence, souris et clavier, raccourcis, notifications, alimentation, applications par défaut, démarrage, utilisateurs, date et langue, imprimantes et stockage. Les modules de KDE ne restent qu'en dernier recours.

optional.busctl: Power, time zone, language, users, input and shortcuts (D-Bus)
optional.kwriteconfig6: Saving the Plasma session's side of a setting

needs.system: Linux with KDE Plasma; X11 or XWayland
